cases.q: Can friends visit me in my room at night?

cases.q: Is there a lifeguard at the pool?

cases.q: Is there a safe in the room for my laptop?

cases.q: What should I do if the fire alarm goes off?

cases.q: I left my charger in the room after checkout

cases.q: What are your base room rates?

cases.q: Why are weekends more expensive?

cases.q: Why do prices change when the hotel is busy?
cases.answer: Rates follow demand. When a room type is 65% or more booked on a night, that night is 10% higher; at 85% or more it is 20% higher. Booking early usually gets a better price. [1]

cases.q: Is there a discount for a week-long stay?

cases.q: What does the WINTER10 code give me?

cases.q: Does the deluxe room have a balcony?

cases.q: How many people fit in the family suite?

cases.q: Does the penthouse have a hot tub?
cases.answer: The Penthouse Suite (95 square metres) is on the top floor with two king beds, a private terrace, a hot tub and a panoramic sea view. It sleeps up to 4 guests. Pets are not allowed. [1]
